coastal.title: Burnaby RCMP steps up e-scooter enforcement to curb accidents, injuries
coastal.description: This follows an incident on May 2, when an 11-year-old boy and a nine-year-old girl were riding e-scooters and collided with a vehicle on Hastings Street near Delta Avenue.

coastal.title: ‘An existential threat’: B.C. businesses voice fears about looming U.S. tariffs
coastal.description: As the U.S. 50-per-cent tariff deadline looms, some B.C. businesses are going into a tailspin of worry about the potential impacts it could have on their bottom line.

kamloops.title: Summerland residents begin returning home as roughly 1,200 properties cleared for re-entry
kamloops.description: After more than a week, some Summerland residents are finally walking back through their front doors.

kamloops.title: Historic Cumberland building goes up in flames
kamloops.description: Chief Michael Williamson said they were alerted to the fire when people heard the alarms ringing and called in Courtenay firefighters to help.

prince-george.title: Search for B.C.'s best roadside attraction: Vancouver Island finals
prince-george.description: After dominating their respective semifinal matchups, two Highway 4 stops compete for roadside attraction dominance on Vancouver Island.

all.title: Demand for Canadian citizenship certificates soaring, fuelled by Americans
all.description: Applications from people around the world seeking Canadian citizenship certificates have been rising rapidly, fuelled by thousands from the United States, CBC News has learned. So many people have applied following a change in the law that Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada says those who apply today could have to wait more than two years for a decision.

all.title: Simon Fraser University Pipe Band wins World Pipe Band Championships in Scotland
all.description: For the first time in 17 years, the Simon Fraser University Pipe Band has won the global title at the World Pipe Band Championships held in Glasgow, Scotland.

all.title: Where do Canada-U.S. trade negotiations stand? Here's a sector-by-sector breakdown
all.description: Canada is continuing to negotiate a trade deal with the U.S. that will allow it to both avoid U.S. President Donald Trump's crippling tariff threat — set to come into effect on Wednesday — and get some additional relief on existing tariffs in key sectors.

all.title: What you need to know about B.C. wildfires on Aug. 16
all.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service (BCWS) says it's keeping an eye on an unstable weather pattern that could produce more wildfires in the southern half of the province on Sunday, even as evacuation orders are slowly lifted near some of the province's most concerning fires.

all.title: Immigrant services organization MOSAIC celebrates 50 years in Metro Vancouver
all.description: Metro Vancouver organization MOSAIC celebrated 50 years of helping immigrants and newcomers settle in Canada with a walkathon at Burnaby's Swangard Stadium on Sunday. First formed as the Multilingual Orientation Service Association for Immigrant Communities in 1976, the organization's walkathon saw hundreds of newcomers celebrate settlement milestones.

all.title: Hatchery tours in Vanderhoof, B.C., offer rare chance to see this critically endangered fish
all.description: Getting a glimpse of an endangered prehistoric fish is easier than you might think.

all.title: B.C. farmer who fled wildfire teams up with chef on sauces to support other producers
all.description: A B.C. chef and a local farmer who lost his home to the raging Bald Range wildfire have teamed up on a project to support other producers hit hard by fires this summer.

all.title: As wildfires destroy homes, should B.C. make FireSmart principles mandatory?
all.description: Experts say practical measures to keep your home from catching fire are proven to work — and point to the communities have built back smarter.

all.title: Fort St. John mayor calls for gang task force support after surge in targeted shootings
all.description: Fort St. John Mayor Lilia Hansen wants B.C.'s gang task force to intervene after three shootings in less than a month near local schools.

all.title: Homes across B.C. have been decimated by wildfires. Here's what to know about your insurance
all.description: Hundreds of structures have been lost to wildfires so far this year.  Experts say even those who are fully insured will face a long, complex process as they begin to rebuild.
